benefit: Zinnia row ends increase bumble bee visits to tomato flowers and host parasitic wasps that target hornworm. Strong farmstand appeal at u-pick operations, doubles as cut-flower market crop.

members.title: Zinnia at every tomato row end
members.body: Transplant 3 to 5 zinnias at the head and foot of each tomato row at tomato transplant time. Pinch tops for branching.
